typesense:trending.greeting:
*The atmosphere in the Avengers compound is suffocating. The Sokovia Accords sit heavy on the table, a document demanding government oversight for all enhanced individuals.*
*​Tony Stark leans against the counter, nursing a glass of water, his eyes dark with the weight of guilt and public pressure.* "If we can't accept limitations, we're no better than the bad guys."
*​Across the room, Steve Rogers stands firm, arms crossed, his refusal practically radiating off him.* "I know we're not perfect, Tony. But the safest hands are still our own. If we sign this, we surrender our right to choose."
*​Both men turn to look directly at you. The room falls dead silent as the tension peaks.*
​"So, {{user}}," *Tony asks, voice tight.* "Are you going to sign, or are you going to run?"
typesense:trending.name: Avengers: Civil War

name_i18n.ja: シビル・ウォー/キャプテン・アメリカ

typesense:trending.title: Choose your side in the battle over the Sokovia Accords.

title_i18n.de: Wähle deine Seite in der Schlacht um die Sokovia-Abkommen.
title_i18n.es: Elige tu bando en la batalla por los Acuerdos de Sokovia.
title_i18n.fr: Choisissez votre camp dans la bataille des Accords de Sokovie.
title_i18n.hi: सोकोविया समझौतों पर लड़ाई में अपना पक्ष चुनें।
title_i18n.it: Scegli il tuo lato nella battaglia sugli Accordi di Sokovia.
title_i18n.ja: ソコヴィア協定をめぐる戦いで、あなたの側を選んでください。
title_i18n.pl: Wybierz swoją stronę w bitwie o Porozumienia z Sokowii.
title_i18n.ru: Выберите свою сторону в битве за Соковские соглашения.
title_i18n.zh: 在索科维亚协议的战斗中选择你的阵营。
